cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT max(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour,
  AVG(wind) AS avg_wind_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE
  ts >= '2026-09-14 23:59:54'::timestamp - INTERVAL '2 days'
GROUP BY
  hour
ORDER BY
  hour

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT DATE(ts) AS day, vessel, MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY day, vessel ORDER BY day, vessel

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_water_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT
  time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minute', ts) AS bucket,
  AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry
WHERE
  vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= '2026-09-14 23:59:54'::timestamp - INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY
  bucket
ORDER BY
  bucket

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour_bucket, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_bucket, vessel ORDER BY hour_bucket, vessel

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', ts) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour

cases.sql:

  strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts) AS hour,

  AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM telemetry

GROUP BY
  hour,
  vessel
ORDER BY
  hour,
  vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT
  CASE WHEN ts BETWEEN '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-09-07 23:59:54' THEN 'First Week' ELSE 'Second Week' END AS week,
  vessel,
  AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM
  telemetry
WHERE
  ts BETWEEN '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND '2026-09-14 23:59:54'
GROUP BY
  week,
  vessel
ORDER BY
  week,
  vessel
